The Automation Platform Dilemma
Short answer: Use Make for visual no-code automation, n8n for code-level flexibility and self-hosting, and ManasN8N for a managed n8n instance with built-in expert support.

If you're exploring workflow automation in 2026, you've likely encountered three names: Make (formerly Integromat), N8n, and ManasN8N. Each serves a different purpose in the automation ecosystem, and choosing the right combination can significantly impact your team's productivity.
This guide breaks down exactly what each platform offers, their ideal use cases, and how they can work together to create a powerful automation stack.

Make (Formerly Integromat)
What It Is
Make is a cloud-based visual automation platform that lets you connect apps and automate workflows without coding. It's known for its intuitive visual builder and extensive app integrations.
Key Strengths
Visual Builder: Drag-and-drop interface that's genuinely intuitive
Huge App Library: 1,500+ pre-built integrations
Reliable Cloud Infrastructure: No server management needed
Great for Marketing Teams: Non-technical users can build complex automations
Limitations
Can get expensive at scale (pricing based on operations)
Limited custom code capabilities
Data stays on their servers (compliance considerations)
Best For
Marketing teams, small businesses, and anyone who wants powerful automation without technical complexity.
N8n - The Developer's Choice
What It Is
N8n is an open-source workflow automation tool that can be self-hosted or used via their cloud offering. It provides maximum flexibility and control for technical teams.
Key Strengths
Open Source: Full transparency and community contributions
Self-Hosting Option: Complete data control and compliance
Custom Code Nodes: Write JavaScript/Python for custom logic
No Operation Limits: When self-hosted, run unlimited workflows
API-First: Easy to integrate with existing systems
Limitations
Steeper learning curve than Make
Self-hosting requires technical knowledge
Fewer pre-built integrations than Make
Best For
Development teams, companies with compliance requirements, and anyone needing custom automation logic.
ManasN8N - The Templates Revolution
What It Is

ManasN8N is a full templates library featuring 6,000+ ready-made N8n workflows. It's the first platform to offer AI-powered search for finding automation templates: simply describe what you need, and get matched with the most relevant workflows.
Key Strengths
AI-Powered Search: Describe your needs in natural language ("I need a social media scheduler workflow") and get matched with relevant templates
6,000+ Templates: Largest collection of N8n workflow templates
Instant Start: Import templates directly into your N8n instance
Free to Use: No cost to browse and use templates
Community-Driven: Templates from real-world use cases
How It Works
Visit manasn8n.com
Describe what workflow you need
AI returns top 3 matching templates
Preview, customize, and import to your N8n
Best For
Anyone using N8n who wants to save time building workflows from scratch. Perfect for finding inspiration and starting points.

Which Should You Choose?
If none of these three feel like the right fit to build and run yourself, it's worth looking at who builds it for you instead; compare agencies before you commit to a tool.
The Power of Combining All Three
The most effective automation strategy often involves multiple tools:
Start with ManasN8N: Find proven workflow templates for your use case
Deploy on N8n: Customize and run with full control
Use Make for simple stuff: Quick integrations that don't need customization
This approach gives you the speed of templates, the flexibility of self-hosting, and the simplicity of visual tools, all working together.
